submitted.rationale: Index 6 (Sb 0.10) had the highest EQE of the 5 measured: 0.0504%. Index 1 (Sb 0.057) gave 0.037%, index 8 (Sb 0.124) 0.045%, index 15 (Sb 0.26) 0.036% and index 24 (Sb 0.52) 0.035%. So the peak is near Sb about 0.10. In XRD, indices 4 and 6 show mostly Pt substrate peaks. A new film peak (Q about 2.07) first appears at index 9 (Sb 0.14), where the film starts to crystallize. EQE falls as Sb rises past that point.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.045%, below index 6. This is the side where EQE drops toward the start of crystallization.

rejected.hypothesis: Sb-rich end (Sb > 0.36), as the Gaussian-process model suggested
rejected.reason: EQE falls from Sb 0.10 to 0.26 to 0.52, so this region is unlikely to beat index 6. The model only picked it because it had no data there.
